title: GET /api/decks/:id/check → consistency (D1555, #3802)
description: What the deck v2 adapter's `consistency` method passes through: the `consistency` key of the deck check's reply (`routes/deck_check.ts`, `services/deckConsistency.ts`), or null for a reader who is not the founder. The free rules, no model and no write. An explicit nullable object refuses other primitive replies. D1511 (#3762).
